source_brief.standout: Angled, baffled fins suggest two different compositions depending on where the audience stands.
source_brief.scene: A physical garden of many vertical ANGLED two-faced fin panels in finite rows, with real dark backing/baffles between luminous faces. Main LEFT-side vantage reveals cyan tree-like contours across the fins; a small lower inset at the alternate RIGHT-side vantage reveals a magenta helix motif assembled from the other faces. Clearly separate angular view zones and dark panel edges; no magical unshielded pixels changing visibility. Minimal gold viewing paths.
